errors.evidence: The red line (LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit) has a maximum value of 0% at the start and never shows a positive relative change. Stating it fluctuates up to 1% is incorrect.
The minimum value for the light blue line (RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit) at Layer13-20 is approximately -6%, not -7%.
The dark blue line (RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit) increases from approximately -14.5% at Layer13-20 to -11% at Layer21-28. The description incorrectly states that it 'further decreases'.
The final value for the dark blue line (RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit) at Layer29-32 is approximately -1.5%, not -3%. The stated value is off by a factor of 2.
